title: Single collection (data + indexes in one place)
Multiple collections (same shape, one entry per collection)
A CRUD session: insert, update, find, delete, count — several statements, run in order
script:
db.collection.insertMany([
  { name: "Barbara", age: 40, city: "Boston" },
  { name: "Alan", age: 41, city: "London" }
])
db.collection.updateMany({ city: "London" }, { $set: { country: "UK" } })
db.collection.find({ country: "UK" }, { _id: 0, name: 1, age: 1 }).sort({ age: -1 })
db.collection.deleteOne({ name: "Tim" })
db.collection.countDocuments({})

script:

db.collection.getIndexes()

title: A text index and $text search
Atlas Search: a search index in the data panel, then $search (needs Atlas or atlas local)
Vector Search: a vector index in the data panel, then $vectorSearch (needs Atlas or atlas local)
createSearchIndex as a statement (instead of the data panel)
Movies: your own data, then filter, group and rank (no sample data needed)
script:
db.movies.find({ year: 1999 }, { _id: 0, title: 1, rating: 1 }).sort({ rating: -1 })
db.movies.aggregate([
  { $unwind: "$genres" },
  { $group: { _id: "$genres", films: { $sum: 1 }, avgRating: { $avg: "$rating" } } },
  { $sort: { films: -1, _id: 1 } }
])
db.movies.countDocuments({ rating: { $gte: 8 } })
